newsitem.title: USA: Payless Cashways revenues up on professional sales.
newsitem.headline: Payless Cashways revenues up on professional sales.

text.p: Payless Cashways Inc said Tuesday its same-store sales were up in each of the three months of the fourth quarter thanks in part to sales to its professional customers.
The company said same-store sales were up one percent when presented on a 13-week basis, although net sales declined 1.3 percent compared to the fourth quarter of 1995.
Payless Cashways said for financial reporting purposes, the fourth quarter of 1996 was a 14-week sales period compared to a 13-week sales period in the fourth quarter of 1995.
The company posted net income of $5.6 million in the latest fourth quarter compared to a $137.4 million loss a year ago, which included a $133.1-million restructuring charge.
Payless Cashways is a building materials retailer.
Its shares closed up 1/8 Tuesday at 2-3/8.
